meta.name: Oops Ab Kya
meta.description:
An accident during a medical check-up changes Roohi's life completely, she must face whatever fate has in store for her.

Complete series. On your server: S1 8/8

videos.title: Kaisi Yeh Hairaniyaan
videos.overview: Roohi's simple yet cheerful life is tossed into a chaotic adventure because of a surprise. What will she do? Erase the mistake or accept destiny's mysterious design?

videos.title: Yeh Baby Kya Kehlata Hai
videos.overview: As Roohi struggles to accept her new role of motherhood, Paakhi faces a blast from the past. While investigating Mayasur, Omkar discovers Alisha's secrets instead.

videos.title: Kasam Se Let's Do It!
videos.overview: Roohi finally decides to lose her virginity to Omkar. Paakhi braces herself to tell Roohi about her father's identity. Alisha tries to recover a clue that connects her to Raj.

videos.title: Lust Mei Marjawan
videos.overview: Samar must prove his strong leadership skills to his father. As Roohi and Omkar attempt to overcome new challenges to get married, she also struggles with her new attraction to Samar.

videos.title: Babul ki Duality
videos.overview: Roohi gets to know Vanraj more, but Paakhi feels left out. Meanwhile, Roohi feels doubtful about the baby's future as Samar informs her of his and Alisha's separation.

videos.title: Mera BF Thanedaar?
videos.overview: Roohi's life turns more chaotic with the arrival of her cousin Peenal. Love is tested for Paakhi and Roohi as Vanraj and Omkar are caught in their respective lies.

videos.title: Sasural Samar Ka
videos.overview: Vandana holds Mikka captive, and Alisha threatens to get custody of the baby to extort more money from Samar. But he and Roohi uncover some surprising facts about Alisha's past.

videos.title: Jab Mila Mayasur
videos.overview: With Subadhra injured, Roohi feels helpless and finds comfort and support with Omkar, who gets dangerously close to uncovering Mayasur's identity.
